### 12. Contract

The checked-fields read is published on `/api/recovery/document/v1/cases/{caseId}/checked-fields` and returns a CheckedFieldSet of CheckedField items with documentId, docVersion, fieldName, value, state and confidence. This is the smallest superset of the legacy list in RWB-E2-025 section 12; S4 and S2 confirm the operation and the field names before the wave 2 release. The accuracy pass mark is the row EXTRACT_ACCURACY_PASS of `document_hub_parameter` (12.7).

SCR-30 and SCR-31, reached through the gateway-bff composite route (BR8), each return and render four states: empty, loading, error and no access. No state carries a field value (BR7).

edits.old: **Probes.** Readiness answers healthy only after the worker has polled `rwb-document` once and the API has answered its health path; liveness answers healthy when the process is up and its internal loop is responsive.
